phase_labeling: future_start=t+1 maps to canonical Raw reset_raw_frame+t+1. Saved case frame_phase labels are used when present; bridge-context frames beyond them use the authoritative source raw phase_id mapping. steer_left/forward/right are rendered as steer.

projection.meaning: Shared 3D spherical PCA-direction visualization only; it is not lossless 256D geometry or a Euclidean-distance plot.
projection.method: u=z/||z||; shared PCA(n_components=3) over reference plus all checkpoints/phases; v=PCA(u)/||PCA(u)|| for unit-sphere display.

reference_sampler: official model.sample_z(4096), seed=4728; standard-normal draw followed by project_z=sqrt(z_dim)*normalize because norm_z=True.
tracking_source: Raw Phase/Raw window -> temporary MotionLib -> AlignedSkateTrackingContext.encode -> tracking_inference
trajectory_lines: First three lexical case_id paths per shown phase; scatter/counts include all actually executed z_t.
